text.title: The open country
text.description: Explore at your own pace. The map is an unfinished chart, not a promise.

monsters.name: Mireling
monsters.description: A mud-caked scavenger with a stone knife.

monsters.name: Ash Wolf
monsters.description: A lean wolf whose coat smolders at the edges.

monsters.name: Hollow Knight
monsters.description: An empty suit of armor, animated by spite.

monsters.name: Bog Wisp
monsters.description: A cold light that has learned to hate.

monsters.name: Roadside Bandit
monsters.description: A desperate robber looking for an easy mark.

events.title: A stranded traveler
events.description: An injured traveler asks for help reaching the next village.

choices.label: Take their purse and leave
choices.result: You leave richer, and less welcome.

events.title: The abandoned shrine
events.description: A neglected roadside shrine holds a few coins beneath its offering bowl.

choices.label: Repair the shrine and leave an offering
choices.result: A quiet blessing follows your party.

choices.label: Strip the shrine of its offerings
choices.result: The coins are yours; the old stones feel colder.

events.title: The merchant’s wagon
events.description: A merchant’s broken wagon blocks the road. Its owner offers a fair reward for help.

choices.label: Help repair the axle
choices.result: The grateful merchant pays you and shares the story.

choices.label: Loot the unattended cargo
choices.result: You take what you can before anyone returns.

text.selection_subtitle: BUILD A PARTY OF UP TO FOUR CHARACTERS
text.selection_intro: Travel a wounded land, face the creatures in its shadows, and decide what your party will become.
text.combat_intro: Each character gets one move: attack, guard, or switch rows. Enemies have a fixed hit chance; characters roll d100 to defend, adjusted by Strength or Agility. A sudden ambush gives enemies the first round; otherwise the party acts first. Melee attacks against the back row provoke the front row.
text.journey_intro: The trail winds toward a land people have nearly forgotten. Prepare supplies and wealth before pushing into the unknown.
text.supply_shortage: The party needs more supply to travel or make camp.
text.win_title: Your party reaches the far country.
text.win_summary: The road remembers every kindness and every trespass.
text.loss_title: Your journey ends before the horizon.
text.loss_summary: The wilds have claimed the last strength of the party.
text.battle_start_log: The party is ambushed by creatures on the road.
text.victory_log: The monsters are defeated. The party gains {wealth} wealth and {reputation} reputation.
text.camp_log: The party camps, spends {supply} supply, and recovers {health} health.
text.guard_log: {name} braces for the next enemy strike.
